description: This script is a Node.js utility designed to test and measure the startup memory usage (RSS) of the 'openclaw.mjs' application on Linux and Mac platforms. It sets up resource usage hooks, runs specific command cases, and compares the maximum RSS against predefined limits, providing guidance for fixing potential memory issues during startup.

methods.name: formatFixGuidance
methods.description: Generates guidance text for fixing startup memory issues based on the test case and details.

methods.name: formatFailure
methods.description: Formats an error message with guidance on how to address startup memory failures.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Parses the stderr output to extract the maximum RSS memory usage in MB.

methods.name: buildBenchEnv
methods.description: Constructs the environment variables required for running the test cases.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Executes a test case, checks the RSS usage, and throws detailed errors if limits are exceeded or issues occur.
